tagline: A San Francisco model lab that trains open-weight models and maintains MergeKit, a widely used toolkit for merging open language models.
about: Arcee AI was founded in 2023 by Mark McQuade, Jacob Solawetz and Brian Benedict to make smaller, specialized language models practical for enterprises. It began by helping teams adapt open models and later moved to training its own models in San Francisco.

Its open tooling includes MergeKit for merging pretrained models, described in a 2024 paper, and DistillKit for distillation. Its current offerings include the Trinity model family, an open source catalog and an API platform.
Investors named on its site include Samsung, M12, Hitachi Ventures and Flybridge. Reporting indicates a 24 million dollar Series A in 2024.

about: Browser Use began as an open-source Python library that lets language-model agents control a web browser, built by Magnus Müller and Gregor Žunič, who met during master's studies at ETH Zurich. It joined Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch.

The company raised a 17 million dollar seed round led by Felicis in March 2025. Today it offers hosted web agents, stealth cloud browsers and Browser Harness, a free open-source tool for coding agents, with enterprise options such as on-premises browsers and an EU cloud in Frankfurt.
